verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs say its Reframe feature 'handles every aspect ratio' and that Modify Video V2 outputs 'all at 1080p', so it natively covers aspect-ratio adaptation and 1080p output for at least one workflow. However, the pack never lists 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 as selectable generation outputs, and never confirms 1080p or higher for text-to-video or image-to-video; Draft mode is documented at only 360p. missing for 10: explicit documentation of 16:9/9:16/1:1 output options for generation, confirmation of 1080p+ resolution for core text/image-to-video, delivery-format details showing no re-encoding is needed, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
